review_rule: A bare source type review lies outside the archived included-source mapping. An explicit external research-review type may support eligibility; anchored nonresearch patterns or explicit excluded roles take priority.
date_conflict_rule: Publication date sources follow date_precedence. Conflicting years within the highest available source kind are unresolved; differing years across source kinds are resolved by precedence in the archived implementation. Generated timestamps are excluded.
punctuation_rule: Unicode/case/harmless punctuation are normalized. Trailing comma/semicolon alone is harmless. A dangling and/& may remain unresolved. Distinguishing campus/place tokens are never stripped.
affiliation_rule: Inspect all author-level raw affiliation strings plus publication-specific structured author affiliations. Exact active focal/historical aliases and evidenced subunit aliases may support. Longer excluded entities block substring matches. Foreign coauthors do not veto a separate clean focal affiliation.
ambiguity_rule: No usable raw affiliation, unresolved historical entity, or unresolved role/date contradiction -> UNRESOLVED. EXCLUDED requires positive evidence of ineligibility/nonmembership.
outcome_firewall: No patent/RCCR outcome information is an input to this resolver.
No work-ID exception may appear in production rules.
Current ROR relationship alone is never positive historical evidence.
Whole-document institution-name hits are ignored unless tied to author-level publication-specific structure.
